adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from other hosts (`users.slice(1)`) who may have `user.destinationCalendar`, this means those team members’ destination calendars are silently not added in the organizer-has-none scenario, undermining the intended “collective multiple host” behavior. Other call sites in the diff use `[]` as the empty fallback, which would allow the push to work.
